instructions.name: create_account
instructions.title: Create account
instructions.rationale: Funds a brand-new account from the payer and sets its owner program; the lamports leave the payer and are controlled by that program.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 0 | lamports u64le @4 | space u64le @12 | owner [u8;32] @20; total 52 bytes. Accounts: 0 [W,S] Funding account; 1 [W,S] New account. Both accounts sign. Fails if the new account already holds lamports or data, or is not system-owned.

instructions.name: assign
instructions.title: Assign owner program
instructions.rationale: Changes the owner program of an account, handing it control of the account's data and lamports. Assigning a wallet account can brick it.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 1 | owner [u8;32] @4; total 36 bytes. Accounts: 0 [W,S] Assigned account public key. The account signs unless it is already owned by the target program (then a no-op). Moves no lamports. The solana-system-interface docs warn that assign and allocate can brick a wallet if used incorrectly.

instructions.name: transfer
instructions.title: Transfer SOL
instructions.rationale: Moves lamports from a signing system-owned account to any recipient address the caller chooses.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 2 | lamports u64le @4; total 12 bytes. Accounts: 0 [W,S] Funding account; 1 [W] Recipient account. Called transferSol in the Codama IDL and @solana-program/system. The sender signs and must carry no data. Report the zero-padded disc8, never the first 8 raw bytes: those include 4 bytes of the amount.

instructions.name: create_account_with_seed
instructions.title: Create account (seed-derived)
instructions.rationale: Funds a new seed-derived account owned by a caller-chosen program. The lamports field follows the variable-length seed, so no fixed-offset spend cap is possible.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 3 | base [u8;32] @4 | seed string (u64le length + utf8 bytes) @36 | lamports u64le @44+L | space u64le @52+L | owner [u8;32] @60+L; total 92+L bytes (L = seed length). Accounts: 0 [W,S] Funding account; 1 [W] Created account; 2 [S] (optional) Base account. amount is null: lamports follows the variable-length seed, so no fixed-offset cap applies (hence defaultDeny). Integrators can read it at 44+len(seed), where len(seed) is the u64 LE at offset 36. The funder and the base must sign (the base may be the funder); the new address must equal create_with_seed(base, seed, owner).

instructions.name: advance_nonce_account
instructions.title: Advance nonce
instructions.rationale: Consumes a nonce account's stored nonce, replacing it with a successor; needs the nonce authority's signature. Moves no funds and changes no authority.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 4; total 4 bytes. Accounts: 0 [W] Nonce account; 1 [] RecentBlockhashes sysvar; 2 [S] Nonce authority. Classified other, not read_only, because it mutates nonce state. Must be the first instruction of a durable-nonce transaction (Anza docs). Fails if already advanced this slot (NonceBlockhashNotExpired) or the account is uninitialized. Raw data is only the 4-byte tag; disc8 pads it with 4 zero bytes.

instructions.name: withdraw_nonce_account
instructions.title: Withdraw from nonce account
instructions.rationale: Withdraws lamports from a nonce account to any recipient; withdrawing the full balance closes the account. Needs the nonce authority's signature.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 5 | lamports u64le @4; total 12 bytes. Accounts: 0 [W] Nonce account; 1 [W] Recipient account; 2 [] RecentBlockhashes sysvar; 3 [] Rent sysvar; 4 [S] Nonce authority. Classified at the stricter account_close; partial withdrawals act like value_out and the amount applies. A partial withdrawal must leave the rent-exempt minimum; withdrawing the full balance resets the state to Uninitialized (Anza docs: the account becomes eligible for deletion). If the nonce account is still uninitialized, its own key must sign instead of an authority.

instructions.name: initialize_nonce_account
instructions.title: Initialize nonce account
instructions.rationale: Sets the authority of an uninitialized, funded nonce account. Requires no signature, so whoever initializes it first chooses who controls it.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 6 | nonce_authority [u8;32] @4; total 36 bytes. Accounts: 0 [W] Nonce account; 1 [] RecentBlockhashes sysvar; 2 [] Rent sysvar. The processor has no signer check, so anyone can initialize a funded, uninitialized nonce account with any authority. The account must be writable and hold the rent-exempt minimum. Normally follows create_account in the same transaction.

instructions.name: authorize_nonce_account
instructions.title: Change nonce authority
instructions.rationale: Hands control of a nonce account, and the lamports in it, to a new authority. Requires the current authority's signature.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 7 | new_nonce_authority [u8;32] @4; total 36 bytes. Accounts: 0 [W] Nonce account; 1 [S] Nonce authority. The current nonce authority signs; fails if the account is uninitialized. Anza docs: grants full control over the account and its balance to the new authority.

instructions.name: allocate
instructions.title: Allocate account space
instructions.rationale: Sets an empty system-owned account's data size. No lamports move, but a system account with data can no longer send System Program transfers.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 8 | space u64le @4; total 12 bytes. Accounts: 0 [W,S] New account. Classified other with defaultDeny: destructive but fits no value or authority class. Once a system account holds data, System transfers from it fail ("Transfer: `from` must not carry data"), so allocating on a wallet bricks SOL transfers. The account signs, must be system-owned and empty; space is capped at MAX_PERMITTED_DATA_LENGTH.

instructions.name: allocate_with_seed
instructions.title: Allocate space (seed-derived)
instructions.rationale: Sets data size of a seed-derived account and assigns it to the owner program used in its derivation, which can strand the account's funds.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 9 | base [u8;32] @4 | seed string (u64le length + utf8 bytes) @36 | space u64le @44+L | owner [u8;32] @52+L; total 84+L bytes (L = seed length). Accounts: 0 [W] Allocated account; 1 [S] Base account. Runs allocate then assign (allocate_and_assign), so it also reassigns the account to owner. The derived address must equal create_with_seed(base, seed, owner) and the base must sign. Moves no lamports.

instructions.name: assign_with_seed
instructions.title: Assign owner program (seed-derived)
instructions.rationale: Changes the owner program of a seed-derived account, authorized by its base key. The new owner controls the account's data and lamports.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 10 | base [u8;32] @4 | seed string (u64le length + utf8 bytes) @36 | owner [u8;32] @44+L; total 76+L bytes (L = seed length). Accounts: 0 [W] Assigned account; 1 [S] Base account. The derived address must equal create_with_seed(base, seed, owner) and the base must sign. No-op if already owned by owner. Moves no lamports.

instructions.name: transfer_with_seed
instructions.title: Transfer SOL (seed-derived)
instructions.rationale: Moves lamports from a seed-derived system account, authorized by its base key, to any recipient the caller chooses.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 11 | lamports u64le @4 | from_seed string (u64le length + utf8 bytes) @12 | from_owner [u8;32] @20+L; total 52+L bytes (L = seed length). Accounts: 0 [W] Funding account; 1 [S] Base for funding account; 2 [W] Recipient account. Called transferSolWithSeed in the Codama IDL. The base (index 1) signs; account 0 must equal create_with_seed(base, from_seed, from_owner) and carry no data. lamports comes first, so offset 4 is fixed despite the variable total length.

instructions.name: upgrade_nonce_account
instructions.title: Upgrade nonce account
instructions.rationale: Permissionless one-time migration of a legacy nonce account's stored version. Moves no funds and changes no authority.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 12; total 4 bytes. Accounts: 0 [W] Nonce account. No signature required. Needs a writable, system-owned legacy nonce account; fails with InvalidArgument if there is nothing to upgrade. Classified other because it rewrites account state.

instructions.name: create_account_allow_prefund
instructions.title: Create account (allow prefund)
instructions.rationale: Like create_account but accepts an already-funded target; transfers any extra lamports from the funder and sets the owner program.
instructions.notes: Wire: u32le tag 13 | lamports u64le @4 | space u64le @12 | owner [u8;32] @20; total 52 bytes. Accounts: 0 [W,S] New account; 1 [W,S] Funding account. Gated by SIMD-0312 (feature 6sPDzwyARRExKH52LECxcGoqziH8G7SZofwuxi8Ja331): InvalidInstructionData while inactive. Active on mainnet-beta since slot 422928004 and devnet since slot 454464000 (feature accounts read 2026-10-10). Account order differs from create_account: new account is index 0, funder index 1 (omitted when lamports is 0). The new account may already hold lamports.
